_comment: Falcon Broadcaster - lists a Minecraft: Bedrock Edition server in the Xbox Live friends list. https://github.com/Falcon-MC/Broadcaster
name: Falcon Broadcaster
author: 96527285+NaySurGithub@users.noreply.github.com
description: Falcon Broadcaster publishes a Minecraft: Bedrock Edition server as a world in the Friends tab of one or more Xbox Live accounts, so players on every platform, consoles included, can join it. This egg downloads a prebuilt Linux binary straight from the GitHub releases.

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
set -euo pipefail

REPOSITORY="${REPOSITORY:-Falcon-MC/Broadcaster}"
RELEASE_VERSION="${RELEASE_VERSION:-latest}"
ASSET_NAME="FalconBroadcaster-linux-x64"

apt-get update -qq
apt-get install -y -qq curl jq ca-certificates file > /dev/null

mkdir -p /mnt/server
cd /mnt/server

if [ "${RELEASE_VERSION}" = "latest" ]; then
    API_URL="https://api.github.com/repos/${REPOSITORY}/releases/latest"
else
    TAG="${RELEASE_VERSION}"
    case "${TAG}" in
        v*) ;;
        *) TAG="v${TAG}" ;;
    esac
    API_URL="https://api.github.com/repos/${REPOSITORY}/releases/tags/${TAG}"
fi

echo "Querying ${API_URL}"

AUTH_HEADER=()
if [ -n "${GITHUB_TOKEN:-}" ]; then
    AUTH_HEADER=(-H "Authorization: Bearer ${GITHUB_TOKEN}")
fi

RELEASE_JSON="$(curl -fsSL "${AUTH_HEADER[@]}" "${API_URL}")"
RELEASE_TAG="$(printf '%s' "${RELEASE_JSON}" | jq -r '.tag_name')"
DOWNLOAD_URL="$(printf '%s' "${RELEASE_JSON}" | jq -r --arg name "${ASSET_NAME}" '.assets[] | select(.name == $name) | .browser_download_url')"
CHECKSUM_URL="$(printf '%s' "${RELEASE_JSON}" | jq -r --arg name "${ASSET_NAME}.sha256" '.assets[] | select(.name == $name) | .browser_download_url')"

if [ -z "${DOWNLOAD_URL}" ] || [ "${DOWNLOAD_URL}" = "null" ]; then
    echo "Release ${RELEASE_TAG} does not contain an asset named ${ASSET_NAME}"
    exit 1
fi

echo "Installing Falcon Broadcaster ${RELEASE_TAG}"
curl -fsSL -o FalconBroadcaster "${DOWNLOAD_URL}"

if [ -n "${CHECKSUM_URL}" ] && [ "${CHECKSUM_URL}" != "null" ]; then
    curl -fsSL -o FalconBroadcaster.sha256 "${CHECKSUM_URL}"
    EXPECTED="$(awk '{print $1}' FalconBroadcaster.sha256)"
    ACTUAL="$(sha256sum FalconBroadcaster | awk '{print $1}')"

    if [ "${EXPECTED}" != "${ACTUAL}" ]; then
        echo "Checksum mismatch, expected ${EXPECTED} but got ${ACTUAL}"
        exit 1
    fi

    echo "Checksum verified"
    rm -f FalconBroadcaster.sha256
fi

chmod +x FalconBroadcaster
file FalconBroadcaster

if [ ! -f broadcaster.json ]; then
    echo "Writing a default broadcaster.json"
    cat > broadcaster.json <<'SETTINGS'
{
  "server": { "host": "play.example.net", "port": 19132 },
  "routes": [],
  "session": {
    "hostName": "",
    "worldName": "",
    "maxPlayers": 20,
    "queryServer": true,
    "updateInterval": 30,
    "signaling": "websocket"
  },
  "accounts": [
    { "name": "main", "token": "cache/token.json" }
  ],
  "friendSync": {
    "enabled": true,
    "updateInterval": 60,
    "acceptRequests": true,
    "removeInactive": true,
    "inactiveDays": 8,
    "maxFriends": 1000
  },
  "cache": { "playerHistory": "cache/player_history.json" }
}
SETTINGS
fi

mkdir -p cache logs

echo "${RELEASE_TAG}" > .broadcaster-version
echo "Installation of Falcon Broadcaster ${RELEASE_TAG} finished"

variables.name: Release version
variables.description: Which release to install. Use "latest" to always pull the newest published release, or a version such as "1.0.0" to pin one.

variables.name: Repository
variables.description: GitHub repository the release is downloaded from.

variables.name: GitHub token
variables.description: Optional personal access token. Only needed if the node hits the anonymous GitHub API rate limit.

variables.name: Target host
variables.description: Address of the server players are sent to.

variables.name: Target port
variables.description: Port of the server players are sent to.

variables.name: Host name
variables.description: First line shown in the Friends tab. Leave empty to show the MOTD of the server.

variables.name: World name
variables.description: Second line shown in the Friends tab. Leave empty to show the MOTD of the server.

variables.name: Max friends
variables.description: Friends each account keeps before it stops accepting requests. Xbox Live allows 1000.

variables.name: Inactive days
variables.description: Friends who have not joined for this many days are removed to keep room in the list.
